boundary: Compares recorded test runs only. No model execution, automatic promotion or rollback. Company administrators only.
readError: Unable to read evaluations. Check company administrator access.
evidenceLimits: Shows up to 100 versions, 100 inputs and 200 recent runs. Older IDs may be entered explicitly.
name: Dataset name
caseRules: Array of {"inputId":"existing input UUID","expected":"exact expected output"}. Input text is loaded by the server. Fixed datasets cannot be edited.
saved: Dataset saved. Retries reuse the same request ID.
invalid: Invalid input. Check IDs and JSON structure.
writeError: Save failed or outcome unknown. Retry unchanged input safely; edits create a new request.
costNotice: Exact-text scorer only, not semantic quality. Costs are a snapshot of recorded harness-issue ledger entries, not a finalized invoice; missing/unpriced evidence is unknown.
blocked: Evidence does not satisfy review criteria
restoreBlocked: Promotion and rollback unavailable: audited atomic whole-version file restore with concurrency checks is not implemented. No skill files changed.
candidate_not_all_passed: Candidate did not pass every case
input_snapshot_mismatch: Frozen input differs from run input
